title: Rethinking GRPO for Large Reasoning Model Safety Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.23085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities but remain vulnerable to unsafe outputs. While Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for safety alignment, its group-relative optimization may provide insufficient safety-directed learning signals. In this paper, we identify two failure modes: advantage collapse, where homogeneous rollout groups yield vanishing advantages, and unsafe diversification, where unsafe behaviors persist and become increasingly diverse. Our theoretical analysis reveals that behavioral consistency weakens within-group safety contrasts, while entropy regularization can diversify unsafe responses when relative signals vanish. To address these challenges, we propose Beacon, comprising Safety Signal Recovery (SSR) and Safety-Utility Decoupled Alignment (SUDA). translated_title: 重新思考GRPO在大型推理模型安全对齐中的应用
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRMs）具备强大的推理能力，但在输出安全性方面仍存在脆弱性。尽管组相对策略优化（GRPO）被广泛用于安全对齐，但其基于组的相对优化可能无法提供足够的安全导向学习信号。在本文中，我们识别出两种失败模式：优势坍缩，即同质化的采样组导致优势信号消失；以及不安全多样化，即不安全行为持续存在并变得日益多样化。我们的理论分析表明，行为一致性会削弱组内的安全对比，而当相对信号消失时，熵正则化会加剧不安全响应的多样化。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Beacon方法，包含安全信号恢复（SSR）和安全-效用解耦对齐（SUDA）两个部分。SSR结合优势引导的轨迹过滤和安全参考监督，以恢复有效的安全学习信号……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了GRPO用于安全对齐时的优势坍缩和不安全多样化两种失败模式，并提出包含安全信号恢复（SSR）与安全-效用解耦对齐（SUDA）的Beacon方法来恢复安全学习信号，提升大型推理模型的安全性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies two failure modes of GRPO-based safety alignment—advantage collapse and unsafe diversification—and proposes Beacon with Safety Signal Recovery (SSR) and Safety-Utility Decoupled Alignment (SUDA) to restore effective safety learning signals for large reasoning models.
